name: Deep PackGen
description: DRL framework that generates adversarial network packets to test and improve network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) against Adversarial ML attacks.
quantified_result: 66.4% average adversarial success rate across ML models and attack types; >45% of successful samples were out-of-distribution.

name: RansomAI
description: RL-based framework integrable into ransomware to adapt encryption algorithm, rate, and duration to evade detection while maximizing damage. Framed as an 'ethical' adversarial tool for defenders to anticipate real attacks.
quantified_result: Evaded Ransomware-PoC detection on a Raspberry Pi 4 testbed with >90% accuracy using Deep Q-Learning + Isolation Forest detection.
dual_use_note: Explicitly flagged in-text as replicable by real cybercriminals/state actors despite defensive intent.

name: CoAtNet-based malware classification
description: Converts malware binaries into grayscale images, classified via the CoAtNet architecture, improving on classical CNN-based malware image classification.

name: BinImg2Vec
description: Malware binary image classifier framework combining self-supervised learning (via Data2Vec) with supervised learning; produces embeddings that aid model explainability.
quantified_result: 4% improvement in classification performance; 0.5% reduction in performance variance across runs, vs. supervised-only baselines.

name: Multi-node multi-class CPS attack detection
description: Algorithm for early detection of cyber-attacks on distributed cyber-physical systems (CPS) via multi-node, multi-class classification.

name: Artificial Immune System IDS (AIS-IDS)
description: Intrusion detection system design inspired by the human immune system, using Self/Nonself and Danger Theory concepts.

name: AI-assisted authentication
description: AI techniques (e.g. facial recognition, keystroke dynamics) applied across authentication scenarios, from building access to smartphone unlock.

name: Active Learning for cybersecurity data labeling
description: Interactive learning method that queries human analysts on high-uncertainty cases to reduce labeling cost and address imbalanced-data problems in cybersecurity ML.

name: Avast-CTU Public CAPE Dataset
description: Open-source labeled dataset (Avast Software + Czech Technical University AI Center) supporting new ML methods for generic malicious-behavior detection.
